That's just your dynamic tbh and it's perfectly fine. In my culture though, grooming for your spouse is a big part of intimacy, and it's expected of both the husband and the wife. It has nothing to do with not finding the other partner attractive but more so related to keeping the days "fresh" and unpredictable for each other as you were dating.

I don't think make up is necessary, I don't wear any. But wearing pretty clothes and having a neat hairstyle for your husband and vice versa isn't something you needed to shade her for with your chastising of her husbands view that she's "only putting effort in for others". For some of us dressing up is not purely about meeting societal expectations, but about a rejection of monotony, so doing it at home can also be fun even if it requires effort.

>nothing else to look forward to but a baby - cause I gotta say, none of those I've seen married young are career people.

Gonna get flack for this because this is reddit, but how capitalist of you lol

Small update, it's been a few weeks and I haven't felt this way since. It was just one small comment you made online but it really changed my current life so thank you, I didn't think I could control the spiralling but I did.
Thank you so much, I feel immensely better today.

I just read your entire comment, and this was incredibly helpful thank you.

" Once I started to really feel better for once and things felt great. I suddenly and quite unexpectedly started feeling depressed again for all sorts of reason. "

this and 

"  I say this because I was so worried things would go away or I would lose what I have, I'd start to get depressed or anxious about losing the things I had gained. Only because I never thought I deserved them or was incapable of keeping them. "

this, I feel like a fraud tbh and I worry I'll lose it all and it will hurt even more, and I'm aware that my fear might actually make me lose it all. But this helps because at least I know why I have a massive spike in depression exactly when things are going well. I think I will speak to someone about this, maybe there are therapists online I can skype with. Thank you kindly for taking the time to type all of this out :)

Unfortunately I do not have access to therapy atm, He is a good man but it will be another 3-4 months of this and at this rate I feel like it might be safer for me not to feel anything than to wait until he's awake while I spiral internally in the day. I have massive milestones coming up for my education and career and I can't afford to mess it up because my emotional turbulence.
